Population increased in Maldon

The estimated population of Maldon in 2024 was 69,131 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

This meant that Maldon's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Maldon increased by 3.8%.

Over this slightly longer period, Maldon was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Maldon

The average (median) age rose to 48.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Maldon has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Maldon is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Maldon's population of 69,131 usual residents was made up of:

  • 11,113 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.1%)
  • 40,094 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58%)
  • 17,924 people aged 65 years and over, (25.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Maldon has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (25.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Maldon, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Maldon
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Maldon, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 202 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 568 births and 770 deaths in Maldon.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 887 (1.3%). There were 3,868 people entering the area and 2,981 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Maldon's population of 44 (0.1%) as a result of 165 people entering the area and 121 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Maldon was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Maldon in mid-2023 is 68,400.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 39 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 34 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 73 people.
